question: The value of 39 – [30 – {33 – (19 – 4 ÷ 3 of 8 × 6)}] is:
solution:
**Given**

39 – [30 – {33 – (19 – 4 ÷ 3 of 8 × 6)}]

**Concept used**

BODMAS rule,

In the beginning solve the bracket values.

Secondary solve the values of 'OF'

Next solve the Division values

Afterwards, Multiply values

And last, solve the addition and subtraction values.

**Calculation**

39 - [ 30 - {33 - (19 - 4 ÷ 24 × 6)}]

⇒ 39 - [30 - {33 - (19 - 4 × 1over 24× 6)}]

⇒ 39 - [30 - {33 - (19 - 1)}]

⇒ 39 - [30 - {33 - (18)}]

⇒ 39 - [30 - 15]

⇒ 39 - (15)

⇒ 24

**∴ The value of 39 – [30 – {33 – (19 – 4 ÷ 3 of 8 × 6)}] is 24.**
